items.title: Super Sloppy Double Dare - Valentine Special (Master Tape)
items.description: This isn’t just any copy of the Super Sloppy Double Dare Valentine Special. It’s believed to be either the original master tape or one of the earliest copies made directly from it. The exact origin is still unclear, but what’s certain is that this isn’t an off-air recording or a VHS dub.
